author: owner
title: Owner: sources de-quarantined as inspiration only; real diversity required
body:
Journals #12 and #13.

- QQP, PAWS, ProofWriter, AmbigNQ, QA2D and SQuAD may be used as inspiration for structure, phenomena and statistics, never copied text; `tools/datasets/no-copy.mjs` proves no row is copied (no 4-gram shared with a row's own source row, no 8-gram with any source, no ids in natural language).
- Corpora must show real linguistic and structural diversity, measured by the diversity auditor; templated variety does not count.

author: orchestrator
title: Why the corpora were rebuilt instead of patched, and the order of work
body:
Journal #18. **Why:** the review found the corpora unfit (unstated negatives in about 64% of the mix, about 70% from one templated corpus, targets predictable from CONTEXT), and the new language removes the model context altogether, so every corpus (sop-agent-3 targets with a CONTEXT shortlist) had to be rebuilt.

**What, in order:** (1) mine a diversity inventory (question types, paraphrase operations, ambiguity types, reasoning depth) from the cached sources, structure and statistics only; (2) generate cases from an intermediate representation and print string targets, with the message as the only model input and the world, ontology and expected result as evaluation-only scaffolding; (3) verify every target by executing it against its world; (4) enforce quotas and split grouping so that the sealed test cannot be answered by template recall; (5) audit a pilot for faithfulness, diversity and leakage; (6) only then regenerate all corpora.

**Not done:** no training; data qualification is a gate separate from the owner's approval.

Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the journal and reports; the timestamp is that of the source event.

author: data-agent
title: Diversity pilot (300 rows) signed off after four auditor rounds
body:

- Diversity auditor round 1: **OBJECTIONS** (single-scenario blocked families, Romanian/English grammar bugs). Sign-off after **4 rounds**.
- Corpus audit PASS, no-copy PASS, 279/279 executed rows agree with intent; `npm test` green.
- Observation after moving the pilot to `datasets/pilot-diversity` (visible in `/audit`): **23 of 27** `assumed` wires restated the queried proposition (circular assumptions) → owner question Q-DATA-4.
- Owner questions Q-DATA-1..3 recorded; full regeneration waited for Q-DATA-1..4.

Journal #56 (train+dev, 29,029 rows): 0% emoji, money/units, clock times, recipient role, ellipsis follow-ups, not-all, coordinated subjects, arithmetic and definitional questions; comparatives, "most" and modals appear only inside numeric constraints; 0.03% of messages exceed 40 words.

author: project-history-agent
title: Why formalizer-v1 was built three times on 2026-09-28
body:
A summary of the journal; each build replaced the previous one on disk.

1. **Build 1 (15:39Z, 33,984 rows):** first corpus in the one model language, after the owner's decisions (one language, no context, Q-DATA-1..4, Q-ARCH-1). The independent auditor refused the first build (~7% label defects) and signed off round 2 (~0.2%).
2. **Build 2 (16:51Z, 33,980 rows):** a manual label review (210 + 55 rows) found systematic defects (relation paraphrases, reasoning in world assumptions, noise on Romanian cue words); fixed in the generator; the defect rate fell from about 4% to 0/150.
3. **Build 3 (19:53Z, 33,981 rows, data final):** evaluation validity (reference-free metrics, accepted golds, tolerant synonyms), canonical English targets (Q-DATA-6), OOD held-out constructions and frames, the long-message family, the noise fix and the Q-LANG words-only expansion. Journal #73 also mentions a rebuild at about 18:25Z that raised targets to about 12.9k characters; it is not separately described in the journal.

Between builds 2 and 3 the training agent's qualification failed closed on the then-current data (journal #77).

author: llm-diversify-agent
title: LLM paraphrase layer (D2): pipeline and 300-row pilot
body: Answer to owner decision D2 ("Can it be done systematically?"): `tools/datasets/llm-diversify/` (DS022 "LLM diversification"). Haiku sees only the message, its verbatim spans and predicate words, never the target; the gold is inherited unchanged. Filters: anchors, cue consistency, an independent Haiku judge with calibration controls, no-copy against the source datasets and the sealed suites (a separate sealed-auditor process), and execution of the unchanged gold. Pilot on 300 train rows (48 families, EN/RO/mixed): 274 of 897 candidates accepted (30.6%), 96% of them new masked templates and 69% new lead-ins against train+dev, $0.0057 per accepted row. Manual reviews found ~2/30 residual meaning shifts, in constraint rows. Accepted rows live only in the report directory; nothing was added to datasets/. Rights: DS014 "LLM-authored text".
